summary: Iteration 7 verification of SocialGrowth. Backend pytest 10/10 pass (GET /api/ ok, POST /api/contact 200 + persisted, 6 invalid payloads -> 422, /api/contact/count increments, public GET /api/contact not exposed). Frontend: BUG FIX 3 CONFIRMED - hovering client-card-crats/guru/yakuza/tolis/scorpios/twisteast at 1920x900 applies an inline inset ring 'inset 0 0 0 1px <accent>80' plus outer glow '0 18px 46px -22px <accent>80'; zoomed per-card screenshots show a complete unbroken rounded ring on all four sides with NO clipping at the top, and each card lifts exactly -6px (matrix translate y -6) while every .marquee-wrap row has padding-top/bottom 6px so the lift is not eaten by overflow:hidden. FIX 4 CONFIRMED - accents come from logoColors.json and differ per card: crats rgb(228,147,67), hairway rgb(246,49,49), kantinarxis rgb(246,246,49), tocashop rgb(67,147,228), xara rgb(235,121,178), papastavrou rgb(246,49,98), funkytokyo rgb(214,81,181); the hover box-shadow colour also differs per card (yakuza 214,181,81 / scorpios 214,81,81 / tolis 235,178,121 / twisteast 225,202,131). FIX 1 - twisteast(480x70), pantheon(620x367), yakuza(620x236), scorpios(480x118) now render as WIDE wordmarks (172px wide, 0.76 of card width) and are legible at 2.2x zoom; tolis is the exception (see minor issues). Audited all 25 logos: zero broken images, zero logos clipped by their card. REGRESSION carousel: 50 cards / 25 distinct clients across 3 rows, 17 client-link-<id> overlay anchors exactly matching the expected site-backed list (doncarlito -> wolt.com/.../cocktails-and-more), the 8 site-less clients (pantheon, funkytokyo, yakuza, ildesto, euthimiou, xara, twisteast, scorpios) have none, social hrefs exact-match (crats ig/fb, hairway fb), document.querySelectorAll('a a').length === 0, ZERO console errors/warnings at 390/768/1024/1920. FIX 5: hero badge + gradient headline + 2 CTAs + 4 platform rows + lg-only floating logo, stats 4 cards 01-04 with accent bar/progress line and counters 100M+ / 25+ / 1,200+ / 4, services 6 cards 01-06, process 4 steps 01-04, contact form + email chip + NEW contact-error (verified: hidden on success, shown inline with Greek copy + toast when /api/contact is aborted), footer logo + 4 socials + copyright; scan for text overflowing its box across hero/stats/services/process/contact/footer returned zero elements. FIX 6 at 390x844: zero horizontal overflow on all 6 sections and documentElement, headings 26px, body 13.5px, sections py 80px, hero CTAs full-width 342px stacked, stats grid 2 cols (165px 165px), services 1 col, email chip 273px (no overflow), cards 196x150 with logo+name+3 social icons unclipped. Responsive: 768x1024 hamburger visible / nav-cta hidden / brand+lang inside viewport, 1024x900 full nav + nav-cta visible and hamburger absent, mobile-nav-cta scrolls contact to top 0. Contact form E2E passed at both 1920 (count 8->9) and 390 (9->10) with the Greek success label on the button.

issues: Tolis logo source is still near-square (429x431) so it renders 68x68 = only 0.30 of card width, i.e. it still looks like a small app-icon rather than the wide wordmark claimed in FIX 1 (it is legible at zoom but the 'Τόλης' wordmark inside is small/soft). Hairway source is only 103x134 so it renders 52x68 (fill 0.23) - smallest logo on the page.

Row vertical padding (6px) exactly equals the hover lift (6px), so the ring is safe but the outer accent glow directly above/below a hovered card is trimmed by the row's overflow:hidden. Cosmetic only - consider py-2.5 for more glow headroom.
Left column (heading + sub + email chip, ~250px tall) is much shorter than the form card (~470px), leaving noticeable empty space bottom-left. Minor asymmetry, not a regression.

action_items: Optional: re-source or pad the tolis.png (and hairway.png) artwork into a wider wordmark so it fills the card like the other 'cut' logos.
Optional: increase .marquee-wrap vertical padding from 6px to ~10px so the hover glow is not trimmed.
critical_code_review_comments: Clients.js ClientCard duplicates the accent value in 4 inline style blocks - fine, but the hover state is React state per card (onMouseEnter/Leave) which re-renders 50 cards' worth of components on every hover; a pure CSS custom-property (--accent) + group-hover would avoid the JS state entirely.
Card uses loading='lazy' inside an infinitely translating marquee; off-screen duplicates may pop in late on slow networks. Consider loading='eager' for the first copy of each row.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 8 requested items for iteration 7 verified green; only cosmetic notes remain (tolis/hairway logo source size, marquee row padding vs glow, contact left-column deadspace). Testing gotchas: (1) inject '.marquee{animation-play-state:paused !important}' for hover tests - using 'animation:none' resets animation-direction so the row-2 reverse check falsely reports 'normal'; (2) hover ring/glow values live in element.style.boxShadow (inline), not computed border; (3) hero badge now has data-testid='hero-badge', platform rows are data-testid='platform-<name>', stat/service/process cards are stat-card-N / service-card-N / process-step-N (0-based); (4) to exercise data-testid='contact-error' use page.route abort on **/api/contact; (5) body has overflow-x:hidden so assert getBoundingClientRect().right vs innerWidth.
rca_of_the_issue: No defects reproduced this round. The previously reported hover-outline clipping is resolved because the 1px border was replaced with an inset box-shadow (which renders inside the element box and therefore cannot be cut by the row's overflow:hidden) and the rows gained 6px vertical padding to absorb the -6px hover lift.
